rationale: The Court is most likely to issue a narrow, standing- and merits-limited opinion upholding ICWA’s core provisions as valid federal rules of decision/preemptive minimum standards, while declining to reach provision-by-provision anti-commandeering attacks on ancillary administrative duties. A concurrence is most likely from Gorsuch (history/tribal sovereignty emphasis) and/or Kavanaugh/Barrett (standing and limiting principles), with Thomas/Alito possible separate writings to cabin doctrine.
